rec.name: How It Works – 3-Step Accordion Section
rec.status: Built — copy delivered, launch not confirmed

what.text: A 'How it works' section that explains the offer in three numbered steps. It has a small eyebrow line ('Personalized sections, no coding'), a headline with the brand name in a logo/script style ('And this is how Sectionfy works'), and three side-by-side columns. Each column has a divider line with a green dot and a 'STEP 1/2/3' label, plus a rounded card with a short step title and a '+' icon that expands the card to show a longer description. In the example the steps are: 1) Buy a section, 2) Add it to Shopify, 3) Customize.

why.text: Breaking the purchase and onboarding process into three simple steps lowers perceived effort and uncertainty, especially for non-technical buyers. Phrases like 'no coding skills needed', 'saves developer costs' and 'start right away' address the main objections up front (complexity, cost, time). The accordions keep the section compact and scannable, and shoppers can open only the step they care about (progressive disclosure). The numbered sequence also gives a clear mental path from purchase to result.

how.text: Build a section with an eyebrow text, a heading (with an optional brand logo or script-font span) and 3 blocks. Each block has a step label, a title and a rich-text description. Lay the blocks out as a 3-column grid on desktop that stacks on mobile. Render each block as a collapsible card (a <details>/<summary> element or a small JS accordion) with a plus icon that turns into a minus when open. Draw the step label with a horizontal rule on both sides and an accent-colored dot. Use a dark background with light text and a green accent, as in the screenshot. Copy per step: STEP 1 – Buy a section: choose your preferred section (hero banner, product slider, testimonials), and it's yours in a few clicks. STEP 2 – Add it to Shopify: follow the clear step-by-step guide to add it yourself, with no coding skills, saving time and developer costs. STEP 3 – Customize: adjust colors, text, images and layout directly in the theme settings to fit your brand.

items: Step description (rich text) shown on expand
Default open/closed state of the accordions
Background and text color, accent (dot) color

dependencies.text: No apps or metafields are needed. It requires a theme that supports sections with blocks (Online Store 2.0) and a small amount of JS/CSS for the accordion. The brand wordmark needs to be supplied as an SVG or image, or set in a script font. The expanded-state design is not visible in the screenshot.

items: Conversion rate of the page (home or landing)
Click-through rate to the product or shop CTA
Bounce rate and time on page

images.caption: Final UI: eyebrow line, headline with script brand name, and three 'STEP 1/2/3' columns with collapsed '+' accordion cards on a dark background.
Layout reference for the step label (dot and divider lines), card styling and plus icon.
